score_notes.christology: He is the One Mediator between God and humans, fully God, fully human.
score_notes.scripture: Therefore, all of Scripture is true, trustworthy, and inerrant in all that it asserts.
score_notes.soteriology: His substitutionary death on the cross provided for the redemption of people from sin and the reconciliation of God and people.
